errors.timeout: Steam did not respond within 20 seconds. Check your connection.
errors.network: Could not reach Steam. Check your internet connection.
errors.rateLimited: Steam's request limit was reached. It will be retried on the next check.
errors.http: Steam returned an unexpected response ({status}). It will be retried on the next check.
errors.badJson: Could not read Steam's response. It will be retried on the next check.
errors.noNews: Steam returned no news for this game (App ID {appId}). Check the game in the settings.
errors.noApiKey: No Steam Web API key has been entered. Add the key in the settings.
errors.invalidApiKey: The Steam API key is invalid or has been revoked. Check the key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey and enter it again in the settings.
errors.steamIdMissing: The Steam account was not recognized. Enter your SteamID (starting with 7656119…) or profile URL in the settings.
errors.steamIdNotFound: This Steam account could not be found. Check the SteamID or profile URL in the settings.
errors.privateProfile: Your Steam profile's game details are private. In Steam, go to Profile → Privacy Settings and set "Game details" to "Public".
errors.noAchievements: This game has no Steam achievements. You can remove it from the achievement cards list in the settings.
errors.friendsPrivate: Your friends list is private, so friends could not be loaded. Make "Friends list" public in Steam privacy settings or add the SteamID manually.
errors.badAppId: Invalid App ID. Search the game by name and pick it from the list.

manifest.description: Notifies you about Steam news for the games you follow and shows your profile, library and achievements on the dashboard.

setup.title: No games added yet
setup.body: Search for the games whose news you want to follow by name in the settings and add them. New news show up here as notifications; when you add a game only its latest 3 news arrive.

games.label: Games
games.help: Search for a game by name and pick it from the results. If you know the App ID, you can also enter it with "Add manually".

patchNotesOnly.label: Patch notes only (Steam's patch notes tag or "patch notes" in the title)

steamId.label: Steam account
steamId.help: For the profile cards, enter your SteamID starting with 7656119… or your profile URL (steamcommunity.com/id/… or /profiles/…). The cards also need an API key.

achievementGames.label: Achievement cards
achievementGames.help: Search for and add the games whose achievement progress you want on the dashboard; each game gets its own card.

friendsOnline.label: Notify when selected friends come online or start a game

friends.label: Followed friends
friends.help: Your friends list must be public. Search for a friend by name or add their SteamID64 manually.

apiKey.label: Steam Web API key
apiKey.help: Required for the profile, library and achievement cards and for friend notifications. Sign in with your Steam account and get a free key, entering e.g. "localhost" as the domain name. The key is stored encrypted on this computer only.

launchGame.title: Launch game
launchGame.description: Launches the game in the Steam client.
launchGame.placeholder: Search by game name or type an App ID
launchGame.name: Game name
